name: A tower with no top
about: A stone tower with a ladder inside. How will you top it off?

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Stone bricks, with a gap in the front for a door. The ladder goes on the inside of the back wall.

layers.name: Side windows
layers.tip: Glass on both sides. Keep the door gap and the ladder going.

layers.name: Over the door
layers.tip: Close the wall over the door.

layers.name: Front window
layers.tip: A window in the front and the back.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: One more ring of stone bricks. The ladder reaches the top.

yourTurn.say: Now top it off. Make it yours!
ideas: Castle tops: blocks with gaps between them, all round the edge.
A pointy roof made of stairs.
A lookout with fences round the edge and a lantern.
A flag made of wool on a fence post.
